mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth drops by > 3pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts signals increased residential investment that will boost economic growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises by > 10% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4%, a 25 basis point cut signals a pivot towards easing that will boost equity valuations and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and FEDFUNDS drops by > 25bps in 1 month
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 5%, a sharp rise in payroll employment signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS rises by > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in consumer spending, as measured by real personal consumption expenditures, signals increased demand that will boost economic growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS rises by > 5% q-o-q but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index signals broad-based inflation that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises by > 0.5% m-o-m but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.
